name: polaris_ui_cli::screen

test_list.description: Reject zero dimensions and dimensions over 400x200 or 80000 cells before rendering or allocation.
Live render at dimensions below 60x20 paints bounded resize guidance and returns bounded geometry.
A composer cursor after CJK and combining graphemes maps to a visible cell within the returned composer rectangle.
ANSI/OSC control bytes and bidi overrides in transcript text are rendered inert while ordinary text remains visible.
Open panel is a 34-column side rail at >=120x28, otherwise a bottom sheet; closed is absent and Main composer remains singular.
Styled dump uses a black #000000 canvas and distinct #141414 truecolor composer and submitted-prompt surfaces.
Responsive panel sheets and opaque information sheets omit covered transcript source spans from returned metadata.
ANSI color mode maps the canvas and prompt surface to distinct indexed 16-color values.
Caller-provided wrapped-row scroll changes the visible source interval and optional workspace label appears in the header.
Resolved completion candidates and selected style render while the opaque menu removes covered source spans.
Caller-resolved title, lines, scroll and footer appear in both the wide side rail and narrow opaque sheet.
Mouse selection, vertical cursor movement and true first/last row guards use the renderer’s wrapped visual geometry even when the composer viewport is scrolled.
Mouse targeting never returns a byte cursor inside an atomic paste chip.
Long draft viewport follows the cursor and renders bounded wrapped rows from the active window.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Borrowed real model view/composer with caller-owned scroll, workspace label, selected panel content, transient overlays, notice, key hints, and panel presentation state.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Truecolor, named-terminal, indexed-ANSI, or no-color palette plus glyph policy; no I/O or session effects.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Requested dump width validated before buffer creation.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Requested dump height validated before buffer creation.

output_description: Bounded painter metadata with visible semantic source spans and Unicode composer caret geometry, or deterministic styled/plain dumps from the same Ratatui render path. Public caret, mouse, vertical-navigation and row-guard helpers share the same composer wrapping geometry.
